videos.title: Everything you need to know about Mobile App UI’s in 8 minutes (beginner friendly)
videos.why: A quick visual primer on mobile navigation, scale, one job per screen, gestures and empty states, with a free Figma file.

videos.title: Steven Hoober - How People Really Hold and Touch
videos.why: A researcher who has run his own studies on grip and touch shows how people really hold phones and how to size touch targets so they work reliably.

podcasts.episode: Episode 139: Every Time We Touch—Josh Clark, author of “Designing For Touch”
podcasts.why: The author of Designing For Touch on how a design feels in the hand, and why touch changes where controls belong.

reads.title: The Thumb Zone: Designing For Mobile Users
reads.why: Explains the thumb zone, the parts of the screen that are easy or a stretch to reach, with real app examples of where navigation and close buttons should sit.

reads.title: Design for Fingers, Touch, and People, Part 1
reads.why: Hoober's own write-up of his research on grip and accuracy, including why people prefer to view and tap the centre of the screen.

reads.title: Touch Targets on Touchscreens
reads.why: How big tap targets should be, why, and how much space to leave between them.
